text: I. Professional Core PositioningAdministrative Management is centered on "Public Affairs Management", focusing on three major areas: government administration, public policies, and governance of social organizations. The aim is to cultivate professional talents with a public awareness and management skills, who can work in government departments, public institutions, non-profit organizations, and administrative departments of enterprises.II. Core Curriculum SystemThe curriculum covers interdisciplinary content and mainly includes: Basic Theory Courses: Administrative Management, Public Administration, Principles of Politics, Introduction to Sociology, Foundation of Law (Administrative Law, Constitution), etc., to establish a basic cognitive framework for public affairs.Professional Core Courses: Public Policy Analysis, Government Economics, Organizational Behavior, Administrative Ethics, Public Sector Human Resource Management, Public Finance, etc., to deeply analyze the administrative operation mechanism.Practical Skills Courses: Social Investigation Methods, Document Writing and Processing, E-Government, Management Information System, Crisis Management Simulation, etc., to enhance the ability to solve practical problems.
